To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“The design of cultural interaction experiences for internationalized automotive user interfaces in order to support intercultural user experience in the car can be achieved through a standardized systematic agile design process that integrates cultural models, standardized process activities from the User Centered Design (UCD) approach (ISO 9241 200) and uses ASPICE as an agile oriented process framework”.
a systematic approach is necessary to ensure the quality of intercultural automotive user interfaces and experiences.
Cultural HCI in the automotive context requires a standardized, systematic and agile approach to ensure the quality of the cultural interaction experience in the car."
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a standardized systematic approach that integrates culture into a user centered design approach for automotive user interfaces/experiences.
the development of a systematic and standardized agile approach to design and develop intercultural user experiences for automotive user interfaces.
the design of cultural user experience in the car.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the approach is able to provide a systematic, standardized and agile design process for the development of intercultural automotive UI/UX design.
the approach is able to produce adequate interaction experiences for users with different cultures and backgrounds.
the presented approach is a first step towards a standardized systematic intercultural agile automotive UI/UX Design process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the approach is able to produce adequate cultural user experiences by integrating culture into the design process.
it can be used for the design of cultural user experiences in the car, and it can be adapted to the automotive industry.
the presented approach is suitable for intercultural automotive user interfaces/experiences design in an agile environment and can be used for the design of cultural user experiences in the car.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the approach is a standardized systematic process that can be adapted to the needs of different cultures.
cultural models can help in the development process of automotive UIs in order to achieve a better understanding of cultural user experiences.
cultural aspects have to be taken into account in every phase of the design process.
